### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bacb3e6a0ff6e8bfdeade49d6830e34fb5522589` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `510bb6c38b02f541462074cef35b143897a7192e` — the merge of head `701d54993ffd1e89db86dfb21d385bc933e0c8ad` into base `bacb3e6a0ff6e8bfdeade49d6830e34fb5522589`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 510bb6c38b02f541462074cef35b143897a7192e && git checkout 510bb6c38b02f541462074cef35b143897a7192e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin bacb3e6a0ff6e8bfdeade49d6830e34fb5522589 701d54993ffd1e89db86dfb21d385bc933e0c8ad && git checkout -B drift-repro bacb3e6a0ff6e8bfdeade49d6830e34fb5522589 && git merge --no-ff 701d54993ffd1e89db86dfb21d385bc933e0c8ad

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bacb3e6a0ff6e8bfdeade49d6830e34fb5522589
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `701d54993ffd1e89db86dfb21d385bc933e0c8ad`
Local-runs: probe — `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` (self-test, then the gate) on head `701d5499` and on base `ca54eaca` in two detached worktrees, removed afterwards, to confirm the new anchor is in the gated population; nothing else was built or run.
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts, docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md + packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts (`isSameOriginApiTarget`, `isHeadlessInvokableAction`, `headlessActionTypeError`, `SERVER_DISPATCHED_ACTION_TYPES`, `buildApiActionRequest`, `invokeBusinessAction`), packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts (the REST door's forward), packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts (the bridge's `isHeadlessInvokableAction` filter), ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx and ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx (the console's `apiHandler`), scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs (the gate that holds the anchor), .changeset/27610-adr-0066-d4-api-actions-door.md (read only for the stale-landing-note question)

Inputs: `git diff origin/main...FETCH_HEAD` (2 files, +5 / −7, one commit on base `ca54eaca`, merge base clean against `origin/main` `bacb3e6a`), the PR body and its two comments (6515776463 docs-drift bot, 6515788043 the claim), card #27694 and its five comments (6506768233, 6513062223, 6513910736, 6514960778, 6515779258), card #27611 (open, with PR #27793 open against it), the dev report at /mnt/project-files/skills-lane-seat2/report-27694.json, and the head's check-runs.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept set: unchanged — correct.** The only hunk in `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` is inside the JSDoc block above `requiredPermissions`. The `z.array(z.string()).optional().describe(...)` line is a context line in the diff; `git diff ... | grep -c "^[-+].*describe("` is 0. No key, value, default or refinement moves, so no published accept set changes and no `content/docs/references/` page regenerates. Clause-② no holds; this record answers the path leg on `packages/spec/src/**`.
2. **Door clause: fully removed and was false — correct.** On head, `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts#isHeadlessInvokableAction` (line 1026) returns `isSameOriginApiTarget(action?.target)` for `type === 'api'`, and `headlessActionTypeError` (line 1562) answers `null` when `type === 'api' && isSameOriginApiTarget(action?.target)`. Both come from #27649 (`481ade61c`), which `git merge-base --is-ancestor` confirms is an ancestor of both `origin/main` and the head. The removed sentence ("the door still refuses `type: 'api'` (`isHeadlessInvokableAction` admits `script`, `flow` and the declarative update only)") was therefore false on `main`; no fragment of it survives in the new paragraph.
3. **Rewording around the cut: every remaining sentence is true.** "ADR-0066 records the decision" — the dated D4 amendment is in the file. "The server half, the ruling's step 2 (#27506), is on `main` (#27649)" — #27649's title names #27506 and the commit is on `main`. "Until step 3 (#27611) lands the console fetches `target` directly" — #27611 is open; `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` `apiHandler` (lines 411–499) builds `url = resolvedTarget.startsWith('http') ? resolvedTarget : baseUrl + resolvedTarget` and calls `authFetch(url, init)`; `RecordDetailView.tsx` `apiHandler` (lines 1422–1537) mirrors it. Neither posts to `/api/v1/actions/:object/:action` for an api action. PR #27793 is open against #27611 but not merged, so the clause stays true on `main`. "Card #27694 removes this paragraph when it does" — matches seat 1's note 6506768233 (second pass drops the console clause and closes the card). The deviation is justified: a bare cut would have left "Until it [the server half] lands the console fetches `target` directly", which is false. The retained date "as of 2026-10-29" is consistent with #27649's merge on that date.
4. **ADR anchor: resolves, and the sentence around it reads true.** `isSameOriginApiTarget` is `export function` at `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:1083`. Its body — non-string or length under 2 false, must start with `/`, second char must be neither `/` nor backslash — is exactly the ADR's "starts with exactly one `/` and goes on past it (`/` alone, `//host` and `/\host` are not)". "The door holds the interpolated path to the same test before it forwards" — `buildApiActionRequest` re-tests `isSameOriginApiTarget(path)` after interpolation (line 1257) and answers 400 otherwise; the REST door calls `buildApiActionRequest` then `forwardApiAction` (`domains/actions.ts:839-843`) and the MCP bridge goes through `invokeBusinessAction` (`domains/mcp.ts:871`), which calls `buildApiActionRequest` at line 3348. "The route and the bridge" — both consume `isHeadlessInvokableAction` (`mcp.ts:832`, `action-execution.ts:3216`). The scheduling clause "once the symbol is on `main`, card #27694 rewrites this citation" is gone; `grep "card #27694"` on the head ADR returns nothing. The kept parenthetical "(PR #27649; the door holds the interpolated path ...)" is unchanged in meaning.
5. **Gate population: the anchor is held.** Local probe: head 611 symbol anchors (585 declaration, 26 literal), 2161 file-level; base 610 (584, 26), 2162 file-level; self-test and gate exit 0 on both. The +1 declaration / −1 file-level pair is exactly this citation (the bare `action-execution.ts` path became a declaration anchor). This matches the PR body's numbers.
6. **No generated artifact is owed.** `git grep "Landing, as of 2026-10-29"` on the head tree hits only the source file; no `api-surface/*.json`, `api-surface-signatures.json`, `declaration-map`, `docs/` snapshot or `content/docs/references/` page carries the docblock paragraph. The dev report records a clean tree after a whole-tree build and `check:docs` exit 0, consistent with that reading.
7. **PR body declarations present and correct.** `Part of #27694` (not `Fixes`, per 6506768233); `Clause-②: no`; `Metadata-protocol: none`; label `skip-changeset` on the PR; Check Changeset skipped by the label. Author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.

### ② Semver level

No release. `skip-changeset` is right: the diff changes a JSDoc paragraph and ADR prose; the `.describe()` text (the published description and the generated references) is byte-identical, and no runtime behaviour or type moves. The shipped `.d.ts` bytes of `@objectstack/spec` change in a comment only, which the review rules class as shipped bytes, not the published accept set. The prior #27664 changeset (`.changeset/27610-adr-0066-d4-api-actions-door.md`) already carries the `Metadata-protocol: semantic` record of the meaning change; this PR adds no meaning. Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flags: `open_questions` is empty. Three declared deviations: (1) rewording around the cut — accepted, see ① item 3; (2) no dated amendment note — accepted, see ④; (3) `skip-changeset` via pr_create and no assignees — procedural, not a contract matter.
- Independence: the diff was produced by `session_016WV4d1LtiXudcBaRgY2xRg` on branch `claude/project-thread-vovpce`; this record is rendered by `session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS`, which did not draft the diff. The claim 6515788043 names this head.
- Cross-domain: the `packages/spec` docblock edit rides the `domain:skills` card under the exception declared in claim 6514960778 and admitted by triage 6513910736.
- Tier: Tier H (`docs/adr/**`, `packages/spec/src/**`); the maintainer merges. Draft PR, `mergeable_state: blocked`.
- CI (check-runs on head at 2026-10-30T05:36Z): 0 failed. Green: Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Auto Label, Dogfood Regression Gate, Plan Test Core shards. Still in progress: Lint · repo and tooling gates (this is the job that runs `check:adr-symbol-anchors`), Build Core, Build UI Deps, Live E2E UI, Test Core 1/8–8/8. Skipped by design: Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Build Docs, UI Published Artifacts, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Verify CLI, the opt-in harnesses. The all-green condition for landing is not yet met at the time of this record; the local probe covers the one gate this diff can turn red.
- The docs-drift bot comment 6515776463 lists nothing and says so is not a clean bill; the diff names no derived anchor, so nothing is expected there.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md` against its first consumer and execution plan.** The first consumer of the D4 same-origin definition is the door itself (`isSameOriginApiTarget` and the forward), and the anchor now binds the prose to that symbol: a rename or move turns `check:adr-symbol-anchors` red, which is what the card asked for. The three-step execution plan in the amendment note is untouched and still accurate as a dated record (step 1 this record, step 2 #27506/#27649 landed, step 3 #27611 open).
- **No dated amendment note — right call.** `docs/adr/README.md` and AGENTS.md reserve the amended-status-line / new-ADR form for a reversed or changed decision (Prime Directive 13). Replacing a bare name with an anchor changes no decision. The #13556 migration (the gate's own header, `scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs`) moved 300+ anchors across 35 ADRs without per-ADR notes; the single "Anchor note (#13556)" is ADR-0113's, written because its re-anchor dropped to file level over a row known to be stale, and it explicitly says it did not repair the prose. Sampled on head: ADR-0066 (3 path#symbol anchors), ADR-0126 (3), ADR-0131 (4) carry no anchor note. My own count of ADRs with `packages/...ts#symbol` anchors is 52 (the thread says 53; the one-off is regex width, not a dispute). The rewrite also executes a step the 2026-10-29 amendment itself scheduled, under the paragraph's existing dated label, so provenance is already recorded.
- **`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` against the ruling it implements.** The ruling (6513910736 and the card) says drop the door clause only and keep the console clause; the paragraph does that and nothing more. The published description still says "on every call the platform action door ... dispatches", which was written to stay true across the landing, and it does.
- **The two noted findings.** Both are real and neither belongs in this PR. (a) The Status line "The server half lands under #27506; see the note under D4." is present-tense and the half has landed; it is outside the card's D4 hunk and the ruling's file surface, and the status line is the single fact the README guards, so it should move with the second pass as a status amendment, not ride a first pass that the ruling scoped to one citation. Should-fix, carrier second pass. (b) The amendment note's "Until step 2 lands the door still refuses `type: 'api'` ... so no agent can invoke a `type: 'api'` action today, and the console still fetches `target` directly" is a dated record whose condition has resolved; the ADR house form keeps dated notes as written (ADR-0113 is the precedent for not repairing prose under an anchor change). Leave it. One additional observation, not a finding: the pending `.changeset/27610-adr-0066-d4-api-actions-door.md` Landing bullet reads "Until it lands the door still refuses `type: 'api'`"; it is a conditional that has resolved and a release-owned record once versioned, so it is not owed here.
- Cited code was read to judge the prose, not reviewed.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-vovpce`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Must-fix: none.

Should-fix:
1. (carrier: #27694 second pass, not this PR) ADR-0066 Status line: amend "The server half lands under #27506; see the note under D4." to record that it landed (#27649, 2026-10-29), in the same pass that drops the console clause once #27611 is on `main`.
2. (carrier: landing, not a code change) Landing waits for the in-progress check-runs: Lint · repo and tooling gates, Build Core, Build UI Deps, Live E2E UI and the 8 Test Core shards were still running when this record was written; the maintainer's Tier H approval should follow their convergence.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0066 的 D4 段改用符号锚点 `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts#isSameOriginApiTarget` 引用同源判定，不再写裸文件名；删掉「卡 #27694 落地后改写本引用」的排期句。`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` 中 `requiredPermissions` 的 JSDoc 去掉一句已不成立的「门还拒收 `type: 'api'`」（#27649 已在 main 上放行同源 api 动作），保留「#27611 落地前控制台仍直接请求 `target`」。2 个文件，+5/−7，`skip-changeset`。
- 为什么改：卡 #27694 的第一遍。#27649 合入后，那句门子句变成假话；ADR 用符号锚点引用后，一旦重命名或移动，`check:adr-symbol-anchors` 会转红。
- 风险与回滚：只改注释和 ADR 散文。`.describe()` 文本、类型、行为都不变，生成的 references 页逐字节相同，revert 即回滚。
- 先看：ADR-0066 D4 段那一处锚点，再看 `action.zod.ts` 中 `requiredPermissions` 的 JSDoc。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` exit 0（锚点数 611，比 base 多 1 条声明锚点，少 1 条文件级锚点）。
- 需要你做的：登记册判 Tier H（`docs/adr/**`）。请批准本 PR（契约复核 PASS 6515866455，`Head-sha: 701d54993ffd1e89db86dfb21d385bc933e0c8ad`）。

席位意见：ACCEPT。契约复核 PASS，没有 must-fix。should-fix 1：ADR-0066 的 Status 行仍是现在时（"The server half lands under #27506"），转到 #27694 第二遍，与删控制台子句一起改，因此本 PR 写 `Part of #27694`，卡保持打开。should-fix 2（等 CI 收敛）已满足：现在全绿。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** one PR, `Part of #27694` (not `Fixes`; the second pass removes the console clause after #27611 lands), two files: `docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`, `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` (JSDoc only, no `.describe()` byte moves). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `skip-changeset`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 27965`: Tier H (`docs/adr/**` ×1), 12 changed lines.
- **前提实测:** `isHeadlessInvokableAction` and `headlessActionTypeError` admit a same-origin `type: 'api'` on main (#27649, an ancestor of the head), so the removed door clause was false. Both console `apiHandler`s (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`) still fetch `target` directly, so the kept clause is true. `isSameOriginApiTarget` is exported at `action-execution.ts:1083` and matches the ADR's definition (review ①2–4).
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `701d54993ffd1e89db86dfb21d385bc933e0c8ad`: 55 check-runs, 40 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending; `mergeable_state` clean. This includes Lint · repo and tooling gates, which runs `check:adr-symbol-anchors`.
- **接受的偏差:** the sentence around the cut is reworded so it doesn't say the server half is still pending (a bare cut would have left a false "Until it lands"). There is no dated amendment note: an anchor change alters no decision, and that follows the #13556 migration's form (review ④).
- **范围外去向:** ADR-0066 Status line → #27694 second pass. The amendment note's dated "Until step 2 lands" stays as a dated record (ADR-0113 precedent).
- **落地条款:** Tier H: after a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval, the seat lands it under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (seat thread, 2026-10-29 22:04Z).
